_comment: Example personal config. Copy to ~/.config/nanocode/personal.json (chmod 600) and fill in real secrets. NEVER commit the real file — it is gitignored (**/personal.json). Values live repo-OUTSIDE under ~/.config/; the repo only carries this example + the loader code.

_fields.linear.apiKey: Linear API key (lin_xxx). Used by Linear helpers. Optional — falls back to ~/.config/linear-api.key.
_fields.aigw.base: LiteLLM gateway base URL. Optional — defaults to https://aigw.meshy.team.
_fields.aigw.key: AIGW virtual LLM key. Optional — falls back to ~/.config/meshy-aigw.key.
_fields.aigw.budgetUsd: Local monthly budget in USD (key-side max_budget is null for virtual keys). Defaults to 1000.
_fields.remote.machines: Read-only SSH dev-machine seeds merged ahead of the address book. Each: {alias, type:'ssh', host, user, port?, key, note?}. The key is a PATH (never content); sshPassword (if used) is server-side only. Optional — null/absent = no personal machines.
_fields.claude.teams: Extra Claude team config dirs beyond the auto-discovered ~/.claude + ~/.claude-team*. null = auto-discover only.
_fields.ntfy.url: ntfy notification topic URL. Optional — null disables notifications.
_fields.akari.serverUrl: akari dispatch server URL. Optional — defaults to http://10.18.8.55:9481 (env AKARI_SERVER_URL). Not a secret.
_fields.akari.lensUrl: akari lens dashboard URL for the one-click jump button. Optional — defaults to http://10.18.8.55:9482 (env AKARI_LENS_URL).

_permissions._comment: Permission gate (MES-13824): a plugin receives a field ONLY if its manifest declares the matching 'personal.*' permission. Secrets (linear.apiKey / aigw.key) are never sent to the frontend in plaintext — only masked (lin_…xxxx) + hasKey. Real values are server-side only (resolvePluginSecrets).
_permissions.personal.linear: unlocks linear (masked) — for a Linear plugin/helper
_permissions.personal.aigw: unlocks aigw (base/budget + masked key) — declared by the usage plugin
_permissions.personal.remote: unlocks remote.machines (host/user/port/key-path, no secrets) — declared by the remote plugin
_permissions.personal.akari: unlocks akari.serverUrl + akari.lensUrl (not secrets — projected in full for display + the lens jump)
